Package com.apigateway.app.security

Class RequestLimitFilter

java.lang.Object
com.apigateway.app.security.RequestLimitFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Filter
@Component public class RequestLimitFilter extends Object implements jakarta.servlet.Filter
Filter that limits the number of requests a client can make per second. Prevents clients from exceeding a predefined rate limit.
